question: Why is Shambhu saluted as auspicious and prosperity-rich in this half-form?
premises: forehead half and eye half are mentioned
inference: The verse salutes Shambhu in a half-form marked by auspicious and prosperous qualities.
uncertainties: exact relation between Hari half and Shambhu half is compressed
plain_english: I salute Shambhu, the all-auspicious doer and rich in all prosperity, in this half-form with forehead, eye, equal foot, and auspicious thread.
